spec.title: Add a retry to the export upload
spec.content:
## Build

The export job uploads the archive once and fails the run on a network error. Wrap the upload in `uploadWithRetry` (3 attempts, 2 s apart) in `src/export/upload.ts`; the caller in `src/export/run.ts` changes by one line. One test: the first attempt fails, the second succeeds.

## Open choices

1. Attempts: 3 or 5. Default 3; changing it later is one constant.
2. Back-off: fixed or doubling. Default fixed; a later switch is one function.

No verdict in 24 hours: I go on with the defaults.

issue.title: Add a retry to the export upload

spec.title: Charge for the export API from the second tier
spec.content:
## Build

Add a paid plan to the export API: a Stripe product, a price of 9 EUR a month, a `plan` column on `accounts`, and a 402 from `/export` above 100 calls a day on the free plan. Files: `src/billing/plan.ts`, `src/api/export.ts`, one migration.

## Open choices

1. Price: 9 or 15 EUR. Default 9; changing it later is a new Stripe price and a migration of subscribers.
2. Free limit: 100 or 500 calls a day. Default 100; one constant.

No verdict in 24 hours: I go on with the defaults.

spec.content:
